meta.description: Introduce typing improvements incrementally without destabilizing delivery. Use when raising type coverage or strictness.

copy.tagline: 逐步提升类型覆盖与严格度，不破坏交付节奏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中渐进式引入或加强类型检查
copy.tagline_en: Incrementally improve type coverage and strictness without destabilizing delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to introduce or tighten type checking in a project gradually

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你逐步提升 Python 代码的类型注解质量，同时避免破坏现有功能。它会先收集仓库证据，然后生成一份类型迁移计划，并确保类型检查通过。
howto.when: 当你需要提高代码的类型覆盖率或严格程度时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个模块制定类型迁移计划。
检查当前类型覆盖率，并建议下一步升级。
say.note: Claude 会分析现有代码并给出增量改进方案。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you incrementally improve Python type annotations without destabilizing delivery. It collects repository evidence, produces a typing migration plan, and ensures the type checker passes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to raise type coverage or strictness.

say_en.text: Create a typing migration plan for this module.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a plan using Protocol, TypedDict, etc.

say_en.text: Check current type coverage and suggest next upgrade.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze existing code and propose incremental improvements.
